coverage.visual_review: Japan NRS PDF pages 5-8; KMT and CCP NRS PDF pages 3-7, complete pages including continuation tables and footnotes.

possessed_since_turn_start.description: Placement land must have been possessed since the beginning of the current Player Turn.

factory_supplied_capacity_held_since_tur.description: Factory has a Supply Path, available production capacity, and possession since turn start; damage and upgrades do not restore capacity until the following turn.

factory_or_retained_decentralized_produc.description: Ordinary major-power factory placement applies, with the source exception that Chinese infantry-class units and Cavalry can still use Decentralized Production during the nation own evolution turn.

shipyard_supplied_capacity_held_since_tu.description: Shipyard has a Supply Path, available production capacity, and possession since turn start.

major_shipyard.description: Capital ships require a Major Shipyard.

decentralized_chinese_home_country.description: KMT/CCP minor infantry-class units and Cavalry may be placed in Chinese Home Country held since turn start without a factory. The ability persists through their own evolution turn only.

militia_per_zone_purchase_limit.description: Purchased Militia use the land-zone IPP placement cap, minimum one; non-Originally owned zones permit at most one per turn. Recruitment rolls are exempt.

major_militia_outside_home_country_inven.description: A Major Power also has an outside-Home-Country Militia inventory cap; Home Country has no inventory cap.

ccp_soviet_rail_production.description: RCL-004: require the actual CCP-to-Soviet undamaged railroad in Production. The USSR-excluded campaign context disables this prerequisite; generic supply and Mongolian control do not satisfy it.

ccp_soviet_rail_connected_land.description: Artillery/AAA bought via Comintern Brothers must be placed in the CCP land zone with that qualifying railroad.

kmt_burma_road.description: Burma Road opens only from July 1938, while Japan and KMT are at war, KMT possesses Yunnan, and Allies possess Burma. The closed campaign context disables this prerequisite because Burma is outside its map.

kmt_burma_road_yunnan.description: Minor KMT artillery/AAA bought with an open Burma Road is placed in Yunnan.

home_country.description: The construction or upgrade site is in the building nation Home Country, independently of present possession.

started_at_site.description: Facilities are placed where construction began.

airbase_per_zone_limit.description: Only one Airbase may be built per land zone.

coastal_border.description: Naval facility, naval base or Coastal Artillery is placed at the applicable land/sea border.

facility_city_naval_limit.description: A city supports at most one minor plus one major naval facility, across ports/dockyards/shipyards. This rule does not supply a non-city facility cap.

land_or_sea_border.description: Fortification faces a border of the possessed land zone and can protect against land attacks, amphibious assaults and airborne assaults.

fortification_per_border_limit.description: Only one Fortification may be built on a border.

passable_land_border.description: A new railroad must cross a passable land border; impassable terrain is prohibited.

foreign_border_peace_and_permission.description: A new railroad into another nation requires peace and that corresponding player permission.

no_uncontrolled_neutral_endpoint.description: An uncontrolled neutral nation does not permit a new railroad into its land.

railroad_route_cost_2.description: Ordinary terrain at the route crossing costs 2; do not infer from endpoint terrain alone.

railroad_route_cost_4.description: Any listed terrain at the route crossing costs 4.

upgrade_owned_instance.description: The specific existing unit or facility is owned/possessed by the upgrading nation.

upgrade_target_buildable.description: The nation must be able to build the target type to buy its upgrade.

upgrade_in_supply_path.description: Upgrade delivery requires a Supply Path to the receiving unit or facility land zone; if no suitable instance can be reached, the upgrade remains queued.

upgrade_unit_not_placed_this_turn.description: A unit cannot be upgraded in the Player Turn it was placed on the board.

upgrade_at_existing_site.description: Facility upgrade replaces the existing facility at its site.

notes: Base prices remain as printed. Improved Construction discounts/acceleration are technology quote rules, not duplicate purchase rows.
Registering a unit or facility does not grant national purchase access. Only matching chart rows do.
The generic national charts retain excluded-source mechanics as prerequisites; Kido Butai is not a purchase grant and no Soviet prerequisite is substituted by Mongolia.
Placement predicates are data contracts for later phase/pathfinding handlers. This catalog does not implement spending or placement phases.
